description: State model tests for property type detection

testCases: classifyControllerType detects discrete from 0/1 bounds (forward and reverse)
classifyControllerType detects continuous from range > 1 (dB, Hz, gain examples)
classifyControllerType uses unit heuristics (discrete units, continuous units with non-0..1 bounds)
classifyControllerType returns unknown when indeterminate (0..0.5 bounds, null input)
ProLinkControllerState exposes controller type in reset and observe
controller type resets on property change and invalidates value
